title: Ride-Hailing Marketplace Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily zone activity from a fictional Indonesian super-app into fulfillment and supply-shortage KPIs, 7-day supply-shortage risk scores, pickup ETA anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Fulfillment rate, unfulfilled requests, supply shortage hours and GMV in IDR for 40 service zones across Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan and Denpasar.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to zone-day rows.
The shortage-cause chart shows which causes cost the most hours, including the two city-wide flooding days.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of marketplace KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which zones should the supply team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each zone's probability of a supply shortage in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags pickup ETA outliers per zone, and the forecast projects marketplace-wide unfulfilled requests for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are driver payouts and compliance keeping up?

talking_points: Driver payout on-time rate, driver document coverage and pending checks frame the supply-side gaps.
Payout on-time rate against shortage hours by zone shows where late payouts and shortages move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, zone, shortage-cause and risk tables only.
show: Payout on-time rate and document coverage
Payout on-time rate vs shortage hours
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a request finds no driver right now?

talking_points: Live trip request events land in RAW.LIVE_TRIPS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs UNFULFILLED requests with a playbook hint and the zone's current risk band, then emails the on-call analyst.
tabs.call_out: From an unfulfilled request to an incident in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 17 synthetic supply-shortage playbooks.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the playbooks it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
